about_the_game:
Pulse is an open world time trial racer. Each day a different selection of checkpoints forms the daily challenge. The order in which you go through these is up to you.

You control a hover ship that can drift and glide, and has a lightning fast boost. Boosting is limited. You start every run with boost available and going through a checkpoint will replenish it. 

A run typically takes between 10 and 30 seconds. You can try as often as you like. You will see the other players' best times, but not the route they took. At the end of the day, the fastest players get a medal. And the next day you get to see the replay of the winner.

Pulse is all about finding the optimal route and then executing it to perfection. Shaving off those last milliseconds to get your hands on the gold medal of the day.

mac_requirements.minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2.9 GHz or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX650 or AMD equivalent
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Mac OS 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 3.6 GHz or AMD equivalent

short_description: Pulse is a fast-paced time trial racer where you pilot a high-speed hover ship through open environments. Each day, a new set of checkpoints forms the daily challenge — hit them all in any order, find the perfect route and compete for the fastest time on the global leaderboard.
